pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu cóng gāngpiàn shàng táiqǐ láishí , tǎ wéi yǐwéi yǎnshì yǐjīng jiéshù .
pairs.english: When Instructor Vey lifted both hands from the steel strips, Tavi thought the demonstration was over.

pairs.target: tóngkuài què méiyǒu huíqù .
pairs.english: But the copper weights didn't return.
pairs.hanzi: 铜块却没有回去。

pairs.english: One side stayed low, the other high. The second-year girl assisting tapped the table; only at the fourth tap did the strips slowly return.
pairs.hanzi: 一边仍低着，另一边仍高着。帮课的二年级女生轻轻敲桌，敲到第四下，钢片才慢慢退回原来的位置。

pairs.target: jiàoshì lǐ jìng le yíshùn , suíjí yǒurén zhàn qǐlái , xiǎng kànkàn lǎoshī shìbushì hái pèng zhe shénme .
pairs.english: The room fell quiet a moment; then someone stood to see whether the teacher was still touching anything.
pairs.hanzi: 教室里静了一瞬，随即有人站起来，想看看老师是不是还碰着什么。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xiùkǒu juàn dào zhǒu shàng , yòu bǎ dèngzǐ wǎnghòu nuó , lùchū zhuōxià kōng zhe de dìfāng .
pairs.english: She rolled her sleeves to her elbows and moved her stool back, revealing the empty space under the table.
pairs.hanzi: 她把袖口卷到肘上，又把凳子往后挪，露出桌下空着的地方。

pairs.target: " méiyǒu ànxiàn . yě búshì jiào nǐmen huíqù ná zìjǐ de piānzi yìng shì . "
pairs.english: “No hidden cord. And this doesn't mean you should force your own strips to do it back in your rooms.”
pairs.hanzi: “没有暗线。也不是叫你们回去拿自己的片子硬试。”

alignment.english: force your own strips to do it

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái dīng zhe tóngkuài . zuótiān zài yuànzi lǐ zhǎnshì de shuāng líng jià , bìxū yǒurén yìzhí bǎshǒu dā zhe .
pairs.english: Tavi still stared at the weights. Yesterday's paired bells had needed someone's hands to stay in contact.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还盯着铜块。昨天在院子里展示的双铃架，必须有人一直把手搭着。

pairs.target: tā cóngméi juéde zhè yǒu duō qíguài . kě gāngcái nà jǐxià qīng xiǎng zhījiān , liǎngzhī kōng chūlái de shǒu yǐjīng néng qù ná bēizi , fān yíyè zhǐ , zuò biéde shì .
pairs.english: He had never found that strange. Yet between those few taps, two freed hands could take a cup, turn a page, do something else.
pairs.hanzi: 他从没觉得这有多奇怪。可刚才那几下轻响之间，两只空出来的手已经能去拿杯子、翻一页纸，做别的事。

pairs.target: zhè shì dìsānshíliù tiān de dì yītángkè .
pairs.english: It was the first class of day thirty-six.
pairs.hanzi: 这是第三十六天的第一堂课。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng dìyīcì tíngzhù xiǎofú biànhuà yǐhòu , yǐjīng zài sāncì liànxí lǐ zhòng zuò guò ; dìèrcì réng yǒu huàngdòng , lìngwài liǎngcì de jìlù jiējìn .
pairs.english: Since first holding a small change, Tavi had repeated it in three practices: the second wobbled, but the other two readings were close.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从第一次停住小幅变化以后，已经在三次练习里重做过；第二次仍有晃动，另外两次的记录接近。

pairs.target: tā yuánlái hái zài xiǎng , shénme shíhòu néng zài duō yí yìdiǎn , xiànzài nàge wèntí hūrán biànxiǎo le .
pairs.english: He had been wondering when he could move a little farther. Suddenly that question seemed smaller.
pairs.hanzi: 他原来还在想，什么时候能再多移一点，现在那个问题忽然变小了。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tāmen xiān kàn yàngpiàn . tāmen bǐ píngshí liànxí de liàng xiē , jiēchù de dìfāng mó chū liǎngkuài zhǎi miàn , wàiyán gè yǒu yìquān hěn qiǎn de cáo .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey first showed them the samples. Brighter than their usual practice pieces, each had a narrow ground contact patch and a shallow groove around its edge.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他们先看样片。它们比平时练习的亮些，接触的地方磨出两块窄面，外沿各有一圈很浅的槽。

pairs.target: búshì kè zhe míngzì , yě búshì tǎ wéi zài gùshì lǐ tīng guò de nàzhǒng fāguāng wénlù .
pairs.english: No names were carved there, nor any glowing patterns from Tavi's stories.
pairs.hanzi: 不是刻着名字，也不是塔维在故事里听过的那种发光纹路。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiān wèn nà quān cáo shìbushì yào kè dé yíyàng shēn . luò héng wèn liǎngpiàn de hòudù yǒuméiyǒu chóngxīn liáng guò .
pairs.english: Mira asked whether the grooves must be equally deep. Lohen asked whether the strips' thickness had been measured again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉先问那圈槽是不是要刻得一样深。洛衡问两片的厚度有没有重新量过。

pairs.target: lǎoshī jiào tāmen bǎ wèntí liúxià , jīntiān xiān fēnqīng kànjiàn le shénme .
pairs.english: The teacher told them to keep their questions; today they should first distinguish what they had seen.
pairs.hanzi: 老师叫他们把问题留下，今天先分清看见了什么。

pairs.target: èrniánjí nǚshēng bǎ lìng yíduì yàngpiàn tuīguòlái . yìbiān de zhǎi miànshàng yǒu yídào héng cāhén , zài guāng lǐ bú tài xiǎn , zhuǎnguò jiǎodù cái kàndéjiàn .
pairs.english: The second-year girl slid over another pair. A crosswise scratch on one narrow patch appeared only when tilted to the light.
pairs.hanzi: 二年级女生把另一对样片推过来。一边的窄面上有一道横擦痕，在光里不太显，转过角度才看得见。

pairs.english: “This pair wouldn't hold yesterday,” she said. “I damaged the edge while grinding.”
pairs.hanzi: “这对昨天没留住。”她说，“我把边缘磨坏了。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěn píngcháng , bǎ piānzi gē huí dāndú de xiǎohé , méi bǎ huàidiào de dìfāng cáng zhù .
pairs.english: She said it matter-of-factly, returning them to a separate little box without hiding the damage.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很平常，把片子搁回单独的小盒，没把坏掉的地方藏住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi nálái gěi tāmen kàn de quán gāishì zuòchéng de dōngxī , biàn shēncháng bózi , yòu kàn le yìyǎn nà dào hén .
pairs.english: Tavi had expected only successes to be shown. He craned his neck for another look at the scratch.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为拿来给他们看的全该是做成的东西，便伸长脖子，又看了一眼那道痕。

pairs.target: dìèrcì yǎnshì qián , wéi lǎoshī bǎ xiǎo tóngkuài de shéng tiáo hǎo , jiào nǚshēng dúchū liǎngbiān de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Before the second demonstration, Instructor Vey adjusted the weights' cords and had the girl read both positions.
pairs.hanzi: 第二次演示前，维老师把小铜块的绳调好，叫女生读出两边的位置。

pairs.target: tā jiēchù gāngpiàn , děng biànhuà tíng wěn , cái táishǒu .
pairs.english: She touched the strips, waited for the change to settle, then lifted her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 她接触钢片，等变化停稳，才抬手。

pairs.target: zhècì qiāo dào dìèr xià , tā biàn chóngxīn pèngshàng liǎngbiān , zhǔdòng jiéshù le tā .
pairs.english: At the second tap this time, she touched both again and deliberately ended it.
pairs.hanzi: 这次敲到第二下，她便重新碰上两边，主动结束了它。

pairs.target: tóngkuài suíjí huíluò , búbì děng mǎn gāngcái nà jǐxià .
pairs.english: The weights immediately returned, without waiting out the earlier interval.
pairs.hanzi: 铜块随即回落，不必等满刚才那几下。

pairs.target: " néng liúxià , bù děngyú zhǐnéng děng tā zìjǐ sàn . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Keeping it doesn't mean you can only wait for it to fade,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “能留下，不等于只能等它自己散。”她说。

pairs.target: hòupái yǒurén wèn , shìbushì móguāng le jiù xíng .
pairs.english: Someone in the back asked if polishing was enough.
pairs.hanzi: 后排有人问，是不是磨光了就行。

pairs.english: “No. How much you lend, how much you keep—you must balance that first.
pairs.hanzi: “不是。你手里借出去多少、留下多少，得先配得准。

pairs.english: Poor preparation won't hold. Poor balance makes your hands suffer first. Stretching the time won't fix that mistake.”
pairs.hanzi: 面没做好，留不住；配得乱，手先受不了。把时间拖长，不能替你补这个错。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn ràng tāmen qù kàn jìlù , búzài yǎn dìsāncì .

pairs.hanzi: 她说完便让他们去看记录，不再演第三次。

pairs.target: yàngpiàn yǒu gèzì de chǐcùn hé zhǔnbèi rìqī , pángbiān yíliè jì zhe duǎn dé jīhū yíyàng de jǐcì tíngliú , yě yǒu liǎng gé xiě zhe méiyǒu liúxià .
pairs.english: Each sample had dimensions and a preparation date. A column listed several nearly identical brief holds, with two entries recording no persistence.
pairs.hanzi: 样片有各自的尺寸和准备日期，旁边一列记着短得几乎一样的几次停留，也有两格写着没有留下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mōlemō zìjǐ liànxí guò de nà duì gāngtiáo . lǎoshī méi ràng tāmen chāi jiàzi , zhī ràng tāmen xiān liáng , zài huà chū jiēchù de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi touched his practice strips. The teacher had them measure and draw contact locations without dismantling the stands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸了摸自己练习过的那对钢条。老师没让他们拆架子，只让他们先量，再画出接触的位置。

pairs.english: Taking up the ruler, he suddenly resented how slowly he wrote the tiny numbers.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿起尺，忽然嫌自己写小格数字太慢。

pairs.english: Mira steadied one end of the ruler and asked why he was hurrying.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把尺的一端按稳，问他急什么。

pairs.english: “I want to know how long it takes to learn.” “Know how much you have measured first.”
pairs.hanzi:
“想知道要学多久。”
“你先知道量了多少。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán zìjǐ yě xiào le , xiàng fāxiàn zhèhuà tīng zhe tài xiàng lǎoshī .
pairs.english: She laughed at herself afterward, as if realizing she'd sounded too much like a teacher.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完自己也笑了，像发现这话听着太像老师。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào bù chūlái duōjiǔ , dītóu yòu kàn nà liǎnggè zhǎi miàn .
pairs.english: Tavi's laugh didn't last. He bent to look at the two narrow patches again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑不出来多久，低头又看那两个窄面。

pairs.target: xià bàn táng kè lún dào tāmen zuò shúxī de liànxí , huànhuí méiyǒu zhǔnbèi guò biǎomiàn de yàngpiàn .
pairs.english: In the second half of class, they returned to familiar practice with samples whose surfaces hadn't been prepared.
pairs.hanzi: 下半堂课轮到他们做熟悉的练习，换回没有准备过表面的样片。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xuǎn le zìjǐ néng tíngzhù de yìxiǎo duàn , méiyǒu zhàozhe lǎoshī gāngcái de yàngzi tíqián táishǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi chose a small interval he could hold; he didn't copy the teacher by lifting his hands early.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维选了自己能停住的一小段，没有照着老师刚才的样子提前抬手。

pairs.target: mǐlā bàochū wèizhì yǐhòu , tā cái sōngkāi , ràng liǎngbiān huīfù .
pairs.english: Only after Mira read the position did he release, allowing both sides to recover.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉报出位置以后，他才松开，让两边恢复。

pairs.target: tā yǒu yìdiǎn shīwàng . búshì méi zuòhǎo , shì zuòhǎo de dōngxī hūrán xiǎnde hěnxiǎo .
pairs.english: He was a little disappointed—not because he'd failed, but because success had suddenly become small.
pairs.hanzi: 他有一点失望。不是没做好，是做好的东西忽然显得很小。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zǒu guòlái , kàndào tā de jìlù , méiyǒu zài kuā tā wěn , zhī wèn tā gāngcái wèishénme méi shì zhe liúzhù .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey looked at his record without praising his steadiness again, only asking why he hadn't tried to retain the effect.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师走过来，看到他的记录，没有再夸他稳，只问他刚才为什么没试着留住。

pairs.target: " zhè búshì nàzhǒng piānzi . " " háiyǒu ne ? " " wǒ yě méi xuéhuì . "
pairs.english: “These aren't those samples.” “And?” “I haven't learned it either.”
pairs.hanzi:
“这不是那种片子。”
“还有呢？”
“我也没学会。”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ xiàtáng kè yòng de cèliáng biǎo fàngdào zhuōbiān .
pairs.english: She nodded and laid next class's measurement sheet at the table edge.
pairs.hanzi: 她点头，把下堂课用的测量表放到桌边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yòu yào chāo yì zhěngyè , fānkāi cái fāxiàn zuǒbiān liú zhe huàtú de wèizhì , yòubiān shì sāncì cèliáng , bú yāoqiú xiě chángjù .
pairs.english: Expecting another full page of copying, Tavi opened it to find drawing space on the left and three measurements on the right, with no long sentences required.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为又要抄一整页，翻开才发现左边留着画图的位置，右边是三次测量，不要求写长句。

pairs.target: " cóng zhèlǐ kāishǐ . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Start here,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “从这里开始。”她说。

pairs.target: xiàkè yǐhòu , tā liúxiàlái bǎ nà zhāng biǎo kàn wán . èrniánjí nǚshēng zài shōu huài yàngpiàn , jiàn tā hái dīng zhe , wèn tā shìbushì xiǎng shì mó .
pairs.english: After class he stayed to read the sheet. Collecting the damaged samples, the second-year girl noticed him staring and asked if he wanted to try grinding.
pairs.hanzi: 下课以后，他留下来把那张表看完。二年级女生在收坏样片，见他还盯着，问他是不是想试磨。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , yòu wèn néng bunéng xiān kàn tā zěnme ná gōngjù .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, then asked if he could watch how she held the tools first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，又问能不能先看她怎么拿工具。

pairs.target: " jīntiān bùxíng , lún dào wǒ xǐ zhèxiē hézi . " tā bǎ yíluò hézi bào qǐlái ,
pairs.english: “Not today. My turn to wash these boxes.” She lifted a stack.
pairs.hanzi: “今天不行，轮到我洗这些盒子。”她把一摞盒子抱起来，

pairs.target: " hòutiān wǔhòu wǒ zài zhǔnbèi jiān , nǐ xiān wèn wéi lǎoshī zhǔn buzhǔn . "
pairs.english: “I'll be in the preparation room the afternoon after tomorrow. Ask Instructor Vey's permission first.”
pairs.hanzi: “后天午后我在准备间，你先问维老师准不准。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi shēnshǒu qù jiē tā zuì shàngmiàn nàge hézi , xiān wèn le yìshēng . tā shuō kěyǐ , biàn bǎ liǎnggè kōng de dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Rather than reaching for the top box, Tavi asked first. She agreed and handed him two empty ones.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没伸手去接她最上面那个盒子，先问了一声。她说可以，便把两个空的递给他。

pairs.target: zǒu dào shuǐcáo biān , tā bǎ hé dǐ fānguòlái , kànjiàn shàngmiàn yídào yidào de jiù cāhén .
pairs.english: At the trough he turned a box over, finding scratch upon old scratch on its base.
pairs.hanzi: 走到水槽边，他把盒底翻过来，看见上面一道一道的旧擦痕。

pairs.target: yuánlái néng bǎshǒu ná kāi de nà jǐxià , qiánmiàn hái fàng zhe zhème duō zuò wán yǐhòu yào xǐ de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Before those few taps with hands freed came so many things to wash when the work was done.
pairs.hanzi: 原来能把手拿开的那几下，前面还放着这么多做完以后要洗的东西。
